lines: - Backend-Batch 7 (4 Dateien, alle voll gelesen, nur Huellen + `TALK TO THE HAND`): `discord/index` (362 Zeilen: Registrierungs-State-Machine, Slash-Dispatch, Reactions, Webhook-Health, Login-Gate), `maintenance` (Cleanup-Dry-Run/Run, Update-Check/Apply), `taskScheduler` (Cron-CRUD mit Admin-/Ownership-Checks, Single-Flight-Reload), `alertManager` (Schwellwert-Loop, DM-Embeds, Alert-CRUD).
